scope: Final editorial and statement/outline comparison against actual Lean source; no mathematical Lean changes or build execution.

items.label: def:local-public-strategy
items.exact_comparison: LocalQuery support/read/locality and PublicStrategy List Bool -> Option LocalQuery match. Executes requires none at terminal history and transmits only query answers. Helper finite; decoders know helper, own original row and completed transcript; all-F correctness and no off-F assumptions retained.
items.outline_assessment: No proof outline; definition compared directly with LocalProtocol, ProtocolTruncation, and GraphSeparatorBound hypotheses.
items.program_role: Defines exactly the original-row interface to which the separator obstruction applies.

items.label: thm:local-adaptive-separator
items.exact_comparison: Matches graph_expected_separator_bound_of_distribution and its uniform specialization exactly: arbitrary normalized nonnegative law, all-F execution/correctness, arbitrary leaf-dependent separators, loss d*b*|S|+b*sum|C|^2, charges 2D_w and 2H(Z).
items.outline_assessment: Finite-family truncation, nonempty virtual-fiber component factorization, correct-subfamily entropy cover, and two conditional Gibbs budgets follow ProtocolTruncation, AdaptiveLeaves, SeparatorLeaf/Count, AdaptiveSeparator and EntropyFibers. Attained-leaf nonemptiness and fixed separator columns are now explicit.
items.program_role: Excludes a fixed fractional broadcast saving when expected separator loss, input deficit and helper entropy are all negligible relative to P.

items.label: cor:local-separator-worst
items.exact_comparison: Matches graph_worst_case_separator_bound: natural B,L,g, nonempty F, finite ambient helper, attained-image cardinal <=2^g, and exact B >= P-L-2(D+g).
items.outline_assessment: Uniform-law averaging and entropy <= logarithm of attained support are exactly the formal argument.
items.program_role: Converts the separator inequality to a candidate rejection test from pointwise broadcast/loss bounds and the attained helper range.

items.label: thm:local-separator-sharpness
items.exact_comparison: Both coefficient endpoints quantify over real c and arbitrary positive b for d=2. Zero-message symmetry family has deficit b; full-cube XOR-helper example has helper entropy b. No simultaneous optimality of all other terms is claimed.
items.outline_assessment: Read both explicit RowCode constructions, their correctness proofs, cardinality lemmas, and exact helper-entropy lemma. Outline describes the same witnesses; direct substitution forces c>=2.
items.program_role: Shows that stronger separator barriers need additional structure or different terms; neither coefficient can be reduced alone.

items.label: lem:local-treewidth-fragmentation
items.exact_comparison: Matches treewidth_fragmentation and treewidth_separator_loss, including L=0 and empty graphs, arbitrary finite decomposition trees, and natural treewidth convention.
items.outline_assessment: Read TreeFragmentation and the calls to weighted_tree_fragmentation, ownership-weight total, and transfer. Bag removal followed by sum|C|^2<=L*d is the implemented argument.
items.program_role: Supplies the integral separator-loss budget used to turn communication savings into a treewidth lower bound.

items.label: cor:local-treewidth
items.exact_comparison: Matches average_treewidth_lower_bound_of_distribution: d,b positive; epsilon any real; a=max(epsilon-2(D_w+H(Z))/P,0); lower bound d*a^2/4+a/2-1. Uniform specialization retained.
items.outline_assessment: Formal proof first obtains all natural-L tests then applies quadratic_bound_of_integer_tests. The floor choice and displayed nonnegative rounding identity give the same correction. Asymptotic prose explicitly specifies d->infinity and b>0.
items.program_role: For high-entropy inputs and small helper entropy, forces linear average treewidth whenever an original-row strategy saves a fixed fraction.

items.label: def:local-recoded-xor
items.exact_comparison: Matches RecodedXorCode, Correct, LocalTo and XorPacket/XorSystem: independent row bijections; fixed singleton/pair coordinate packets; original-row side information; all-input correctness; no helper; same-row and self-pairs allowed.
items.outline_assessment: No proof outline; compared primitive structures and evaluation definitions directly.
items.program_role: Defines the bounded-packet format tested by the XOR obstruction, allowing nonlinear preprocessing and decoding.

items.label: thm:local-xor-distance
items.exact_comparison: Matches both scaled natural and divided real broadcast_lower_bound endpoints for all natural ell. Near means a walk of length <ell, so disconnected pairs are excluded and ell=0 is admitted.
items.outline_assessment: Read transformed bijection, component difference/recovery, raw-square confinement, unanchored size count and their orbit-bound calls. Nonlinear recoding is handled by bijective conjugation of disjoint flips, not an unjustified raw linear-kernel claim.
items.program_role: Limits savings via graph-neighborhood volume and supplies both the bounded-degree and path/cycle obstructions.

items.label: cor:local-xor-degree
items.exact_comparison: Matches fixed_degree_broadcast_lower_bound for d>=2, Delta natural, degree bound and exact error 6 log(max(2,Delta)) P/log d. No connectedness or positive-width premise omitted.
items.outline_assessment: Half-integer-log radius, walk-count ball estimate, (k+1)*delta^k<=d and logarithm conversion match XorDegreeBound. Renamed local delta to avoid shadowing the deficit D.
items.program_role: Rules out fixed fractional savings for fixed maximum degree, including bounded-degree expander support graphs.

items.label: cor:local-xor-cycle
items.exact_comparison: Matches linear_ball_broadcast_lower_bound and cycle embedding/subcycle/path endpoints: d>0, cycle m>0, injective graph homomorphism or all-radius cap 2ell-1, and exact shifted-square-root error.
items.outline_assessment: Read radius choice Nat.sqrt((d+3)/2), ball count via integer offsets, and real-budget optimization. Displayed rational identity is algebraically exact and k<=t<k+1 yields the required bound.
items.program_role: Strengthens the negligible-saving error from O(P/log d) to O(P/sqrt d) on paths, cycles and graphs with the stated linear ball cap.

items.label: def:local-triangular-causal
items.exact_comparison: Matches TriangularRows and CausalRows: orders are permutations; triangular update depends on earlier incoming rows and is bijective in own input; causal update depends on the inclusive incoming prefix and may discard information.
items.outline_assessment: No proof outline; direct comparison with each structure and apply definition.
items.program_role: Specifies the primitive row updates of the two-stage architecture; the own-row bijection condition is the source of block recovery.

items.label: def:local-two-stage
items.exact_comparison: Matches TwoStageRows.apply composition including all three permutations, arbitrary end maps, bijective first/middle maps, and causal second map. TwoStageHelper has arbitrary ambient helper type and selects all branch data.
items.outline_assessment: No proof outline; direct comparison of input, forward, finalMap, apply, and CorrectOn. One row bank and no extra global operation are explicit limitations.
items.program_role: Defines exactly which coupled nonlinear construction attempts the helper-or-deficit obstruction excludes.

items.label: lem:local-block-injective
items.exact_comparison: Matches TriangularRows.block_injective/equiv, blockInjective_rowwise/inverse and TwoStageRows.inverse_block_injective. Equality outside I at input plus inside I at output implies full equality; finite Q only needed for bijectivity.
items.outline_assessment: Induction on order, finite injectivity-to-bijectivity, cancellation of rowwise bijections, and complement I in the inverse argument match the formal proofs.
items.program_role: Derives the recovery property needed for branch counting from the primitive update rules, rather than assuming that property.

items.label: lem:local-branch-count
items.exact_comparison: Matches TwoStageRows.correct_family_card for all finite F, including empty/correlated, and every natural r<=d: cardinal <=2^((d-r)db+r^2b). Alternative exponent P-br(d-r) follows the formal exponent_decomposition.
items.outline_assessment: Read TwoStageRows derived suffix supports and FixedSupportSandwich injection. Middle rows outside I plus raw R-by-J rectangle recover all raw rows in R, then all middle rows by inverse block injectivity, then input by correct transpose output. No extra block property is imposed.
items.program_role: Bounds each fixed branch correctness family, which is the common input to the helper-range and helper-entropy lower bounds.

items.label: thm:local-helper-count
items.exact_comparison: Matches correct_family_count_toll, quarter_count_toll and quarter_helper_bound_of_density. Ambient helper unrestricted; counts include empty F; density D real and g natural. Exact odd-d floor retained.
items.outline_assessment: Partition into attained-helper fibers, apply branch count, multiply by exact exponent complement, and optimize at floor(d/2). Density premise implies nonempty F before logs. Full-cube consequence follows by cancelling 2^P.
items.program_role: Forces a large attained helper range or a large correct-family deficit; full-cube correctness needs at least 2^(b floor(d^2/4)) helper values.

items.label: thm:local-helper-entropy
items.exact_comparison: Matches arbitrary-law and uniform helper_entropy_deficit_bound endpoints and their quarter specializations. All-F correctness, normalized nonnegative law, zero masses allowed, arbitrary ambient helper with entropy on finite attained subtype, exact b floor(d^2/4) charge.
items.outline_assessment: Branch fiber-cardinality bound feeds entropy_le_observation_add_log_fiber_bound; normalization gives H(X)<=H(Z)+log C; exact exponent identity and half-product identity give both charges. Asymptotic d growth and b>0 are now explicit.
items.program_role: For high-entropy input laws forces actual helper entropy near P/4 as d grows, so a heavily skewed helper distribution does not avoid the obstruction.

scope_corrections.change: Virtual-fiber product reasoning now starts with helper/transcript/separator data attained on F, making the needed nonempty witness explicit.
Halting is a required terminal condition but transmits no additional bit; input-dependent public control uses charged query answers.
Generic sparse fixed-XOR summary replaced with bounded-degree row-graph restriction, matching the actual corollary.
Treewidth and quarter-helper consequences explicitly use d tending to infinity and positive entry width. Exact finite helper toll retains both deficit and floor(d^2/4).
Adaptive consequence explicitly charges expected separator loss; bounded-degree fractional-saving prose explicitly assumes b>0, while its finite theorem still allows b=0.

change_summary: Added or sharpened concrete program roles for all 12 proved numbered results and the interfaces in which they apply.
Explained fixed separator columns and the twofold entropy cover; retained the distinction between full virtual fibers and correlated correct subfamilies.
Removed redundant disclaimers, repeated summary language, and comparison to an older path/cycle error.
Preserved all 16 numbered labels and all formal annotations; mathematical theorem statements and Lean source files are unchanged.
limitations: Source-level semantic review is not a fresh Lean kernel check.
No claim of exhaustive novelty verification or of reduction of arbitrary tape computations to these finite models.
